weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start shows overlapping value labels ('120 d28 d5 days') and names ('Red blood cellSkStomach lining') with a cyan ring around the jumble. seg1:mid/end is a bubble chart: '5 day' and '28 days' collide under the mascot's feet, and one giant '3,650 days' disc dominates.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Four tissues whose renewal times span three orders of magnitude (5 to 3,650 days) were put into one area-sized bubble layout. The small bubbles collapse onto each other and their labels overlap, and nothing in the scene shows renewal happening.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show renewal as replacement over time. Use one body silhouette with four tissue zones that flash to 'new' at their own rates, driven by a day counter Data cranks forward. Stomach lining flips every 5 days, skin every 28, blood every 120, and the skeleton barely changes by the end. Give every label its own measured slot so no two overlap.
